description: Pior Labs dependency update policy. See workspace ADR 0002.

packageRules.description: Group minor, patch, pin and digest updates into one PR per repository.
Update Vite and its tightly coupled tooling together.

Better Auth packages are released together and must stay on matching versions, so routine updates move them as one. Renovate still opens security fixes per package; check the companion packages when one arrives.
Keep .node-version, Dockerfiles, engines and Node types on the same Node release, LTS majors only. Matches tags like 26, 26-alpine and 26.13.1.
Own packages are released deliberately, so skip the waiting period and keep them separate.
PostgreSQL versions are owned by platform-deploy (workspace ADR 0001).
